$comment: Shared points parity vectors (PROMPT.md section 7). Run by packages/shared/test/points.test.ts (vitest) and by the guardian Go tests; both must pass unchanged.
functions: call fn(...args) with the default rules and compare with expect (deep equality; blockCompletionPoints compares its total).

sequences: start from initialLedgerState(); for each step convert input.at (ISO UTC) to epoch ms (and escalation.lastCountedAt when present), apply applyLedgerInput, and compare every key present in expect: points and xp are the step deltas, balance is the balance after the step, the rest are LedgerOutcome fields (null means the field is null).
Then summarizeLedger(state, summary) must match expectFinal (todayFocusMinutes = today.focusMinutes, todayGoalMet = today.goalMet).
Expectations were written by hand from the rules; never regenerate them from either implementation.
